$comment: Caches, language and AI caches, and system junk. Paths use templates ({home}, {local}, {cache}, {env:NAME|fallback}...); see definitions/README.md.

rules.name: npm cache
rules.about: Package tarballs npm keeps after every install. Nothing in your projects points here; the next install downloads what it needs.

rules.name: pnpm store
rules.about: pnpm's content-addressed store. Pruning removes packages no project links to any more.

rules.name: Yarn cache
rules.about: Downloaded package archives for Yarn classic and Yarn Berry's global cache.

rules.name: Bun install cache
rules.about: Packages Bun has downloaded. Bun fetches them again on the next install.

rules.name: Deno cache
rules.about: Remote modules and compiled code Deno has cached.

rules.name: node-gyp headers
rules.about: Node headers downloaded to build native addons. Fetched again when an addon is compiled.

rules.name: Cargo registry
rules.about: Downloaded crate archives and their unpacked sources. Cargo restores what a build needs.

rules.name: Cargo git checkouts
rules.about: Git dependencies Cargo has cloned. Cloned again on the next build that uses them.

rules.name: pip cache
rules.about: Wheels and downloads pip keeps between installs.

rules.name: uv cache
rules.about: uv's package cache. Virtual envs that hard-link from it keep working.

rules.name: Poetry cache
rules.about: Packages and metadata Poetry has downloaded.

rules.name: Conda packages
rules.about: Package tarballs and unused packages Conda keeps. conda clean removes only what no environment uses.

rules.name: Go build cache
rules.about: Compiled packages Go reuses between builds. The next build is slower once.

rules.name: Go module cache
rules.about: Every module version Go has downloaded. Downloaded again by the next build that needs it.

rules.name: Gradle caches
rules.about: Dependencies, transforms and build-cache entries Gradle keeps in ~/.gradle/caches. Gradle daemons are stopped first so nothing stays locked; the next build downloads what it needs.

rules.name: Maven repository
rules.about: Your local Maven repository. Anything you installed locally with mvn install is lost too.

rules.name: NuGet packages & HTTP cache
rules.about: Global NuGet packages plus its HTTP and plugin caches. dotnet restore downloads what a project needs again.

rules.name: Playwright browsers
rules.about: Browser builds Playwright downloaded for tests. npx playwright install fetches them again.

rules.name: Docker unused data
rules.about: Stopped containers, images no container uses, unused networks and build cache. Running containers and all volumes are kept; images are pulled again when needed.

rules.name: VS Code caches
rules.about: VS Code's web cache, compiled-code cache, downloaded extension packages and logs. Settings and extensions are untouched. Close VS Code first for the most space.

rules.name: Cursor caches
rules.about: Cursor's web cache, compiled-code cache, downloaded extension packages and logs. Settings and chats are untouched.

rules.name: JetBrains IDE caches
rules.about: Caches, indexes and logs of every JetBrains IDE version. The IDE re-indexes on next open. Settings, plugins and Local History are kept.

rules.name: Cypress binaries
rules.about: Cypress app binaries for every version you have installed. npm install downloads the one a project needs.

rules.name: Puppeteer browsers
rules.about: Chrome for Testing builds Puppeteer downloaded. Fetched again on the next install.

rules.name: Electron downloads
rules.about: Electron and electron-builder downloads (runtimes, NSIS, code-sign tools). Fetched again by the next install or build.

rules.name: Composer cache
rules.about: Package archives and repository metadata Composer caches.

rules.name: Dart / Flutter pub cache
rules.about: Every Dart and Flutter package version pub has downloaded. Also removes globally activated packages; reactivate them with dart pub global activate.

rules.name: Coursier / Ivy cache
rules.about: Artifacts downloaded by sbt, Mill and scala-cli through Coursier and Ivy.

rules.name: Zig global cache
rules.about: Zig's global build and package cache. Rebuilt by the next zig build.

rules.name: vcpkg binary cache
rules.about: Prebuilt C/C++ libraries vcpkg reuses. Without them, packages build from source again.

rules.name: Conan package cache
rules.about: Conan 2's package storage. Profiles and remotes in ~/.conan2 are kept.

rules.name: ccache / sccache
rules.about: Compiler output caches. The next build is slower once.

rules.name: rustup downloads
rules.about: Leftover toolchain downloads and temp files. Installed toolchains are kept.

rules.name: pre-commit environments
rules.about: Hook environments pre-commit builds. Rebuilt the next time hooks run.

rules.name: Gradle wrapper distributions
rules.about: Every Gradle version ./gradlew has downloaded, one per project version. The wrapper downloads the one a project needs on its next build. Gradle daemons are stopped first.

rules.name: Gradle daemon logs
rules.about: Logs and registry files of Gradle build daemons. Daemons are stopped first; nothing a build needs lives here.

rules.name: Maven wrapper distributions
rules.about: Maven versions ./mvnw downloaded. Downloaded again on the next build.

rules.name: Kotlin/Native toolchains
rules.about: Compilers, LLVM and platform libraries Kotlin/Native and Kotlin Multiplatform downloaded (~/.konan). Often several GB; downloaded again by the next native build.

rules.name: Android build cache
rules.about: Caches the Android Gradle plugin and SDK tools keep in ~/.android. Your emulators (avd) and signing keys are not touched.

rules.name: Groovy Grape cache
rules.about: Dependencies Groovy scripts fetched with @Grab.

rules.name: sbt launcher cache
rules.about: sbt and Scala versions the sbt launcher downloaded. Fetched again by the next sbt run.

rules.name: Clojure git deps
rules.about: Git dependencies the Clojure CLI checked out (~/.gitlibs). Maven deps share ~/.m2.

rules.name: .NET workload leftovers
rules.about: Workload packs left behind by SDK updates. dotnet workload clean removes only packs no installed SDK uses.

rules.name: RubyGems package cache
rules.about: The .gem files kept after installing gems. Installed gems keep working; gem install fetches packages again when needed.

rules.name: Bundler cache
rules.about: Gems Bundler downloaded into its global cache.

rules.name: Ruby version manager downloads
rules.about: Source archives rbenv, rvm and asdf downloaded to build Ruby versions. Installed Rubies are kept.

rules.name: Swift Package Manager cache
rules.about: Package repositories and manifests SwiftPM and Xcode cached. Fetched again on the next resolve.

rules.name: Cabal package cache
rules.about: Package tarballs and index Cabal downloaded. Fetched again by cabal update and the next build.

rules.name: Stack Pantry cache
rules.about: Package sources Stack's Pantry downloaded. Installed GHC versions are kept.

rules.name: GHCup downloads
rules.about: Installer archives GHCup kept after installing GHC, Cabal and HLS.

rules.name: Hex package cache
rules.about: Elixir and Erlang packages Hex downloaded. Your Hex credentials in ~/.hex are kept.

rules.name: rebar3 cache
rules.about: Packages and plugins rebar3 cached.

rules.name: Julia precompile cache
rules.about: Precompiled package images. Julia recompiles them the next time packages load; the first load is slower.

rules.name: R renv cache
rules.about: Packages renv caches and links into R projects. Projects using them reinstall with renv::restore().

rules.name: Perl cpanm work files
rules.about: Build directories and logs cpanm and CPAN leave behind. Installed modules are kept.

rules.name: opam download cache
rules.about: Source archives opam downloaded. Installed switches are kept.

rules.name: Nimble packages
rules.about: Nim packages Nimble installed globally. Projects reinstall them with nimble install.

rules.name: Crystal compiler cache
rules.about: Object files the Crystal compiler caches between builds.

rules.name: D (dub) packages
rules.about: D packages dub fetched. Fetched again on the next build.

rules.name: Gleam package cache
rules.about: Packages Gleam downloaded.

rules.name: Elm package cache
rules.about: Elm packages and compiler artifacts. Downloaded again by elm make.

rules.name: LuaRocks cache
rules.about: Rock files LuaRocks downloaded.

rules.name: pdm, Hatch & pipx caches
rules.about: Download caches of pdm, Hatch and pipx. Environments and installed apps are kept.

rules.name: pyenv downloads
rules.about: Python source archives pyenv kept after building versions. Installed Pythons are kept.

rules.name: Corepack cache
rules.about: pnpm and Yarn versions Corepack downloaded for projects that pin them. Fetched again on demand.

rules.name: Terraform plugin cache
rules.about: Provider plugins Terraform cached. terraform init downloads them again.

rules.name: Pulumi plugins
rules.about: Provider and language plugins Pulumi downloaded. Installed again on the next pulumi up.

rules.name: Bazel output and caches
rules.about: Bazel's output base for every workspace plus its repository cache. Stop Bazel servers first (bazel shutdown); the next build starts from scratch.

rules.name: NuGet temp
rules.about: Scratch files NuGet leaves in the temp folder during restores.

rules.name: nvm downloads
rules.about: Node tarballs nvm downloaded to install versions. Installed versions are kept; nvm downloads again only to install a version you removed.

rules.name: Old Node.js versions
rules.about: Node versions installed by nvm, nvm-windows, fnm or Volta, except the two newest of each. A version's global npm packages go with it. A project pinned to one of these (.nvmrc, volta pin) needs it installed again.

rules.name: Volta downloads
rules.about: Archives Volta downloaded (already unpacked into its tool images), plus its logs and temp files. Volta downloads again only to install a version it doesn't have.

rules.name: mise cache
rules.about: Downloaded tarballs and plugin data mise keeps to install tools. Installed tools are kept.

rules.name: SDKMAN! archives
rules.about: Zip files SDKMAN! downloaded to install JDKs, Gradle, Maven and others. Installed candidates are kept.

rules.name: Old IDE-downloaded JDKs
rules.about: JDKs IntelliJ IDEA or Android Studio downloaded into ~/.jdks, except the two newest. A project set to one of these needs it downloaded again from the IDE.

rules.name: Old FVM Flutter SDKs
rules.about: Flutter SDKs installed by FVM, about 1-2 GB each, except the two newest. A project pinned to one runs fvm install again.

rules.name: Dart analysis server cache
rules.about: The Dart and Flutter analysis server's cache. Rebuilt when an editor opens a Dart project; quit editors first.

rules.name: Android Studio caches
rules.about: Caches, indexes and logs of every Android Studio version (including Preview builds). The IDE re-indexes on next open. Settings and plugins are kept.

rules.name: Android SDK partial downloads
rules.about: Interrupted or half-finished SDK downloads. Don't clean while the SDK Manager is updating.

rules.name: Old Android NDKs and build tools
rules.about: NDK versions (1-2 GB each) except the newest, and build-tools except the two newest. A project that pins an older ndkVersion or buildToolsVersion downloads it again on its next build.

rules.name: Emulator Quick Boot snapshots
rules.about: The Quick Boot snapshot of each Android emulator, often several GB. The next start is a cold boot. Named snapshots you saved and the emulators themselves are kept. Close the emulator first.

rules.name: Metro bundler cache
rules.about: React Native and Expo's Metro transform cache in the temp folder. Rebuilt on the next bundle (the first one is slower).

rules.name: Expo Go app downloads
rules.about: Expo Go builds the Expo CLI downloaded to install on emulators and simulators. Downloaded again when needed.

rules.name: Jest cache
rules.about: Jest's transform and dependency cache in the temp folder, entries older than a week. The next test run rebuilds it.

rules.name: Selenium Manager cache
rules.about: Browser drivers and whole Chrome/Firefox builds Selenium Manager downloaded, one per version. Downloaded again on the next run.

rules.name: Firebase emulators
rules.about: Emulator jars and UI bundles the Firebase CLI downloaded; old versions pile up. Downloaded again the next time you start the emulators.

rules.name: Prisma engines
rules.about: Query and schema engine binaries Prisma downloaded. Fetched again by the next prisma generate.

rules.name: minikube downloads
rules.about: ISOs, kic base images and preloaded image tarballs minikube downloaded, often several GB. Your clusters are kept; a new cluster downloads what it needs.

rules.name: Helm cache
rules.about: Repository indexes and chart archives. helm repo update fetches them again.

rules.name: Vagrant temp
rules.about: Vagrant's temp files (leftover box downloads). Boxes and machines are kept.

rules.name: Google Cloud CLI logs
rules.about: gcloud's per-command logs older than a week. Credentials and configurations are kept.

rules.name: PlatformIO cache
rules.about: PlatformIO's download and API cache. Installed platforms and toolchains are kept.

rules.name: ESP-IDF tool downloads
rules.about: Archives ESP-IDF downloaded to install its tools. Installed tools are kept; install.sh downloads again if needed.

rules.name: Arduino downloads
rules.about: Board cores and libraries the Arduino IDE and arduino-cli downloaded (already installed). Downloaded again only to reinstall.

rules.name: Arduino build cache
rules.about: Compiled sketches and cores. The next upload compiles again.

rules.name: Unity package cache
rules.about: Packages the Unity Package Manager downloaded. Fetched again when a project needs them.

rules.name: Godot editor cache
rules.about: The Godot editor's cache. Rebuilt on the next open.

rules.name: Old Godot export templates
rules.about: Export templates for Godot versions other than the newest, about 1 GB each. The editor offers to download them again when you export with that version.

rules.name: Unreal shared DDC
rules.about: Unreal Engine's shared Derived Data Cache (shaders and cooked assets). Rebuilt by the editor; shader compiles can take a long time.

rules.name: Old VS Code / Cursor servers
rules.about: The server VS Code, Cursor or Windsurf installs on this machine for Remote-SSH and WSL, one copy (about 200 MB) per editor update, except the two newest; plus cached extension downloads. The editor reinstalls its server on the next connect.

rules.name: Chocolatey cache
rules.about: Packages Chocolatey downloaded. Installed software is kept.

rules.name: WinGet downloads
rules.about: Installers WinGet downloaded, older than a day. Installed software is kept.

rules.name: pixi / rattler cache
rules.about: Conda packages pixi downloaded and extracted. Environments re-link from it; the next install downloads what's missing.

rules.name: Browser automation leftovers
rules.about: Temp browser profiles, artifacts and transform caches Playwright, Puppeteer, chrome-devtools-mcp and browser-use leave in the temp folder when a run crashes or is killed, older than a day. Persistent profiles that keep you logged in are not touched.

rules.name: Windsurf, Kiro, Trae and Zed caches
rules.about: Web, code and GPU caches, downloaded extension packages and logs of AI editors. Settings, extensions, chats and workspaces are kept.

rules.name: Claude Code temp and scratchpads
rules.about: Each Claude Code session's scratchpad, task output and pasted images in its temp folder (CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR, or the system temp). Only entries older than a day go, so running sessions keep theirs. Claude Code itself never empties this folder.

rules.name: Claude Code temp and scratchpads
rules.about: Claude Code's per-user temp folder (/tmp/claude-<uid> or /private/tmp/claude-<uid>): each session's scratchpad, task output and pasted images. Only entries older than a day go, so running sessions keep theirs.

rules.name: Claude Code MCP logs
rules.about: Full logs of every MCP server Claude Code ran, one folder per project. Claude Code never prunes them; they can grow to many GB. Only logs are deleted.

rules.name: Claude Code debug logs and snapshots
rules.about: Debug logs, shell snapshots, per-session environment, the paste and image caches, and the plugin and skill trash in ~/.claude, older than a day. Transcripts, checkpoints, memory, settings, skills and plugins are never touched.

rules.name: Old Claude Code versions
rules.about: Claude Code binaries the native installer downloaded, except the two newest (the one you run is always among them). A running version is left alone.

rules.name: Claude desktop app caches
rules.about: The Claude app's web, code and GPU caches and its logs. Chats and settings are kept. Quit the app first for the most space.

rules.name: Claude desktop: old Claude Code builds
rules.about: Copies of Claude Code the Claude app downloaded for its Code tab, except the newest. Downloaded again if the app needs an older one.

rules.name: Codex caches
rules.about: Codex's tool, plugin-catalog and model caches. Fetched again automatically. Sessions, memories, auth and config are kept.

rules.name: Codex temp files and logs
rules.about: Per-run temp files, the login log and sandbox logs, older than a day.

rules.name: Codex trace log database
rules.about: logs_*.sqlite: Codex's diagnostic trace log, often hundreds of MB to over a GB. Codex recreates it. Quit Codex (CLI and app) first; while it runs the file is left alone.

rules.name: Old Codex versions
rules.about: Old releases of the standalone Codex CLI and the app's server daemon. The one `current` points to is always kept. The Windows app's old helper copies (one per app build) go too, except the newest.

rules.name: Kimi Code logs and caches
rules.about: Kimi Code's logs, update metadata and caches (Moonshot's own list of what's safe to delete), plus native modules unpacked for older versions. Sessions, credentials, config and skills are kept.

rules.name: DeepSeek Harness cache
rules.about: The cache of DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Sessions and config are kept.

rules.name: agent-browser screenshots and traces
rules.about: Screenshots, diff images, traces and profiles agent-browser saved without a name. Saved logins (sessions/), auth and config are kept.

rules.name: agent-browser old Chrome builds
rules.about: Chrome for Testing builds agent-browser installed, except the newest.

rules.name: OpenCode logs and caches
rules.about: OpenCode's (and Kilo's) logs, saved tool output, cache and temp files. Sessions, snapshots used for undo, and auth are kept.

rules.name: Qwen Code debug logs
rules.about: Qwen Code's debug logs and saved tool results. Chats, checkpoints, memory and settings are kept.

rules.name: GitHub Copilot CLI logs
rules.about: Copilot CLI's process logs and plugin data, plus versions other than the newest. Sessions and config are kept.

rules.name: Old Cursor CLI versions
rules.about: Versions of the Cursor CLI (cursor-agent) except the newest.

rules.name: Old Windsurf language servers
rules.about: Language-server builds Windsurf (Codeium) downloaded, one per update, except the newest. Cascade history and memories are kept.

rules.name: Factory Droid logs
rules.about: Droid's logs and bug-report bundles. Sessions, specs and settings are kept.

rules.name: Crush cache
rules.about: Charm Crush's cache. Projects' .crush databases and config are kept.

rules.name: Goose logs
rules.about: Goose's logs (it deletes them itself after two weeks). Sessions and config are kept.

rules.name: Aider caches
rules.about: Aider's global caches. Chat history files in your repos are kept.

rules.name: Continue logs and index
rules.about: Continue's logs and codebase index. The index is rebuilt in the background, which takes a while on big repos. Sessions and config are kept.

rules.name: Cline cache and logs
rules.about: Cline's cache in VS Code and its CLI logs. Task history and checkpoints are kept.

rules.name: Warp logs and cache
rules.about: The Warp terminal's logs and cache. Its database, history and settings are kept.

rules.name: T3 Code logs and caches
rules.about: T3 Code's logs and caches, its app's web caches, and the throwaway Claude Code sessions it runs only to title a thread (folders named …t3code-claude-title… in ~/.claude/projects). Threads, attachments, worktrees and settings are kept.

rules.name: Ghostex caches and old updates
rules.about: Ghostex's cache and logs, and update packages other than the newest. The app, its state and settings are kept.

rules.name: AI app update downloads
rules.about: Installers that T3 Code, LM Studio and Ollama downloaded for an update. Deleting one cancels that pending update; the app downloads it again.

rules.name: ChatGPT, Antigravity and Cherry Studio caches
rules.about: Web, code and GPU caches and logs of AI desktop apps (ChatGPT, Google Antigravity, Cherry Studio). Conversations, settings and logins are kept. Quit the apps first for the most space.

rules.name: Ollama logs
rules.about: Ollama's server and app logs. Models, chats and keys are kept.

rules.name: LM Studio server logs
rules.about: LM Studio's local server logs. Models and conversations are kept.

rules.name: Jan logs
rules.about: The Jan app's logs. Threads and models are kept.

rules.name: Hugging Face datasets cache
rules.about: Arrow files and map() results from load_dataset. Rebuilt from the Hub the next time a script loads the dataset. Your token and models are not touched.

rules.name: Hugging Face assets & legacy cache
rules.about: Library assets, remote-code modules, the xet shard cache and the pre-2022 transformers cache that newer versions no longer read.

rules.name: torch.compile / Triton / vLLM caches
rules.about: Kernels compiled by torch.compile (Inductor), Triton, torch C++ extensions (DeepSpeed ops) and vLLM. Recompiled on the next run; only the first run is slower.

rules.name: PyTorch hub & checkpoints
rules.about: Pretrained weights fetched by torch.hub, torchvision and older timm. Downloaded again on first use.

rules.name: Keras / TF Hub downloads
rules.about: Datasets and weights from keras.utils.get_file and keras.applications, and TensorFlow Hub modules. Downloaded again on demand.

rules.name: TensorFlow Datasets downloads
rules.about: Raw archives TFDS downloaded before preparing datasets. Prepared datasets and files you placed in downloads/manual are kept.

rules.name: Weights & Biases cache
rules.about: Artifact and media cache W&B keeps locally. Runs on wandb.ai and local run folders are not touched.

rules.name: Gradio temp files
rules.about: Uploads and outputs Gradio apps wrote to temp. Only items older than a day are removed.

rules.name: GPU shader caches
rules.about: Compiled shaders and CUDA kernels cached by NVIDIA, AMD, Intel and DirectX. Rebuilt as apps run; the first launch after is a little slower. Close games and GPU apps first.

rules.name: Scoop download cache
rules.about: Installers Scoop downloaded. Installed apps are kept.

rules.name: Temp files
rules.about: Your user temp folder. Only items older than a day are removed, and anything in use is skipped.

rules.name: Crash dumps
rules.about: Memory dumps written when apps crashed. Only useful when reporting that crash.

rules.name: Xcode DerivedData
rules.about: Build products and indexes for every Xcode project. Rebuilt on the next build.

rules.name: CocoaPods cache
rules.about: Pod specs and sources CocoaPods caches. pod install fetches them again.

rules.name: Simulator caches
rules.about: Caches for iOS simulators. Your simulator devices are kept.

rules.name: Homebrew cache
rules.about: Downloaded bottles and source archives. brew cleanup removes the old ones.

rules.name: Temp files
rules.about: Your files in /tmp. Only items older than a day are removed, and anything in use is skipped.

rules.name: Homebrew cache
rules.about: Downloaded bottles and source archives from Homebrew on Linux. brew cleanup removes the old ones.

rules.name: Unfinished downloads
rules.about: Downloads that never finished (.crdownload, .part, .download, .partial), in your Downloads folder and on every drive chosen in Settings. They can't be opened; download the file again if you still need it.

rules.name: Thumbs.db files
rules.about: Hidden thumbnail caches older Windows versions and network shares leave in folders of pictures and videos, found on the chosen drives. Windows rebuilds them only if it needs them.

rules.name: Steam shader caches
rules.about: Shaders Steam compiled for each game, in every Steam library on the chosen drives. Games rebuild them; the first launch after may stutter briefly.

rules.name: Old disk images & installers
rules.about: Disk images and installers in Downloads older than a week (.dmg, .iso, .pkg, .msi, .exe setup files). Usually installed already, but they are your files: check before deleting.

rules.name: Recycle Bin
rules.about: Files you deleted earlier, on every drive chosen in Settings. Emptying it can't be undone.

rules.name: Trash
rules.about: Files you deleted earlier, on every drive chosen in Settings. Emptying it can't be undone.

rules.name: Error reports (yours)
rules.about: Crash and hang reports Windows Error Reporting keeps for your apps. Only reports older than 30 days are removed.

rules.name: Thumbnail & icon cache
rules.about: Explorer's thumbnail and icon databases. Rebuilt as you browse folders. Explorer keeps the current ones open, so those are skipped.

rules.name: Internet cache
rules.about: Temporary Internet Files used by Windows, Office and older apps (Disk Cleanup's "Temporary Internet Files").

rules.name: Chrome cache
rules.about: Chrome's web, code and GPU caches for every profile. Cookies, history, passwords and tabs are not touched. Files in use while Chrome runs are skipped.

rules.name: Edge cache
rules.about: Microsoft Edge's web, code and GPU caches for every profile. Cookies, history and passwords are kept.

rules.name: Brave cache
rules.about: Brave's web, code and GPU caches for every profile. Cookies, history and wallets are kept.

rules.name: Firefox cache
rules.about: Firefox's disk cache for every profile. Your profile (bookmarks, history, logins) is not touched.

rules.name: Discord, Slack & Teams caches
rules.about: Web and GPU caches of Electron chat apps. Messages and logins are kept; quit the apps first for the most space.

rules.name: Microsoft Teams cache
rules.about: The new Teams app's cache and diagnostic logs (Microsoft's own fix for a slow Teams). You stay signed in. Quit Teams first.

rules.name: Postman cache
rules.about: Postman's web and code caches. Collections and environments (in IndexedDB) are not touched.

rules.name: Windows temp
rules.about: C:\Windows\Temp, used by installers and services. Only items older than 7 days are removed; anything in use is skipped.

rules.name: Windows Update downloads
rules.about: Update packages Windows already downloaded. The update services are stopped while this runs and restarted after; anything still needed is downloaded again. Don't run it while an update is installing.

rules.name: Delivery Optimization cache
rules.about: Update files Windows keeps to share with other PCs. Cleared with Microsoft's Delete-DeliveryOptimizationCache.

rules.name: NVIDIA driver downloads
rules.about: Driver packages the NVIDIA app and GeForce Experience downloaded and already installed. The installed driver is not touched; a new download happens only for the next update.

rules.name: NVIDIA installer cache
rules.about: Copies of every component the NVIDIA installer has set up (Installer2). Only entries older than 30 days are removed. Repairing or removing an old NVIDIA component may then need the driver package again.

rules.name: Error reports (system)
rules.about: Windows Error Reporting's archive and queue. ReportQueue can grow to many GB. Only reports older than 30 days are removed.

rules.name: Memory dumps
rules.about: Dumps Windows writes after a blue screen. Useful only when diagnosing that crash; dumps older than 30 days are removed.

rules.name: Windows servicing logs
rules.about: Old component-servicing (CBS) logs. The active log is kept; logs older than 30 days are removed.

rules.name: Component store cleanup
rules.about: Removes superseded Windows component versions with DISM. Safe and supported by Microsoft; takes several minutes. Size is known only after it runs.

rules.name: Previous Windows installation
rules.about: Windows.old from the last upgrade. Deleting it removes the option to roll back to your previous Windows version. Windows deletes it on its own about 10 days after an upgrade.

rules.name: App caches
rules.about: ~/Library/Caches for your apps. Apps rebuild them as needed. Apple's own caches and the developer caches on the Disk cleanup page are left out.

rules.name: Your logs
rules.about: ~/Library/Logs: app logs and crash reports. Only items older than 7 days are removed.

rules.name: Chrome cache
rules.about: Chrome's disk cache for every profile. Cookies, history and passwords are kept.

rules.name: Brave cache
rules.about: Brave's disk cache. Cookies, history and wallets are kept.

rules.name: Edge cache
rules.about: Microsoft Edge's disk cache. Cookies, history and passwords are kept.

rules.name: Firefox cache
rules.about: Firefox's disk cache for every profile. Your profile is not touched.

rules.name: Safari cache
rules.about: Safari's web cache. Needs Full Disk Access for Dev Cleaner (System Settings → Privacy & Security); without it, nothing is removed.

rules.name: iOS DeviceSupport
rules.about: Debug symbols Xcode copies from every iPhone/iPad OS version you connected. Copied again the next time a device connects.

rules.name: Unavailable simulators
rules.about: Simulators for iOS versions no longer installed. Removed with xcrun simctl delete unavailable.

rules.name: Xcode archives
rules.about: Archives of apps you built for release. Keep the ones you shipped if you may need their symbols.

rules.name: iPhone & iPad backups
rules.about: Local device backups. Apple: a deleted backup can't be recovered. Needs Full Disk Access.

rules.name: Mail attachments cache
rules.about: Attachments Mail saved when you opened them. They stay in the messages and download again when opened. Needs Full Disk Access.

rules.name: Quick Look cache
rules.about: Preview thumbnails for Quick Look. Reset with qlmanage -r cache.

rules.name: System logs
rules.about: /Library/Logs and /var/log. Only log files older than 7 days are removed; the active logs are kept.

rules.name: Time Machine local snapshots
rules.about: Local snapshots macOS keeps between backups. Thinned with tmutil; your backups on the backup disk are not touched. Size is known only after it runs.

rules.name: Thumbnail cache
rules.about: Thumbnails file managers created. Rebuilt as you browse.

rules.name: Chrome / Chromium cache
rules.about: Disk caches of Chrome and Chromium. Cookies, history and passwords live in ~/.config and are kept.

rules.name: Brave cache
rules.about: Brave's disk cache. Your profile in ~/.config is kept.

rules.name: Edge cache
rules.about: Microsoft Edge's disk cache.

rules.name: Firefox cache
rules.about: Firefox's disk cache for every profile. Your profile is not touched.

rules.name: Mesa shader cache
rules.about: Shaders compiled by the open-source GPU drivers. Rebuilt as apps and games run.

rules.name: Unused Flatpak runtimes
rules.about: Runtimes and extensions no installed app uses any more.

rules.name: System journal
rules.about: Archived systemd journal files older than 7 days. The active journal is kept.

rules.name: Core dumps
rules.about: Memory dumps of crashed programs kept by systemd-coredump. Only useful when debugging that crash.

rules.name: APT package cache
rules.about: Downloaded package files the package manager keeps after installing. Installed software is not affected.

rules.name: DNF package cache
rules.about: Downloaded package files the package manager keeps after installing. Installed software is not affected.

rules.name: Pacman package cache
rules.about: Downloaded package files the package manager keeps after installing. Installed software is not affected.

rules.name: Old Snap revisions
rules.about: Disabled older revisions Snap keeps for rollback. The current revision of every snap stays.
